description: A bank of sixteen tuned voices from one pitch: each takes the incoming pitch, multiplies its frequency by one whole number and divides it by another, and hands back its own pitch and velocity

params.text: Scales the velocity modulation input that feeds every channel at once, 0 to 100%
Scales the velocity modulation input beside it for this channel alone, 0 to 100%
Scales the velocity reaching this channel, 0 to 100%
Scales the pitch modulation input that feeds every channel at once; the setting is raised to the fourth power and it inverts below the middle
Scales the pitch modulation input beside it for this channel alone; the setting is raised to the fourth power and it inverts below the middle
Sets the whole number this channel's frequency is multiplied by, 1 to 96; it is the left half of the ratio on the display
Sets the whole number this channel's frequency is divided by, 1 to 96; it is the right half of the ratio on the display
Detunes this channel, adding up to 0.03V either way, which is 36 cents up or down
Switches this channel in and out. Only channel 1 is on when the module is added, and a channel that is off takes no place on the polyphonic outputs.
Restricts the module to its own group of four channels and clears whichever group was chosen before; with none of the four on, all sixteen channels are used

inputs.text: The gate for the voices, passed through to one channel of the gate output for each active channel
A retrigger for the voices, passed through to one channel of the retrigger output for each active channel
The velocity all the channels start from, before each channel's own velocity knob
Modulates the velocity of every channel, scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates the velocity of this channel alone, scaled by the knob beside it
The pitch all the channels are built on, one volt per octave
Modulates the pitch of every channel, scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates the pitch of this channel alone, scaled by the knob beside it
A rising edge chooses the mixture of the same number and clears the other three

outputs.text: The gate input on one polyphonic channel per active channel
The retrigger input on one polyphonic channel per active channel
Every active channel's velocity on its own polyphonic channel
This channel's velocity on its own, monophonic
Every active channel's pitch on its own polyphonic channel, one volt per octave
This channel's pitch on its own, monophonic, one volt per octave

notes: fifteen of the sixteen channels come up switched off, so a new module gives one voice at the pitch it is fed. Switch the further channels on before expecting a chord.
the polyphonic outputs pack the active channels in order with no gaps, so channel 5 lands on polyphonic channel 2 if it is the second one switched on.
the ratio of the two whole numbers is what the channel plays: 3 over 2 is a fifth above, 1 over 3 is two octaves and a fifth below, and 1 over 1 is the pitch as it came in.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.
